dishes.name: Cağ kebab
dishes.desc: Goat or lamb marinated for about a day, then cooked on a horizontal spit and sliced onto skewers. It is Erzurum's signature dish, also called Oltu kebab after the nearby town.

dishes.name: Stuffed kadayıf
dishes.desc: Shredded kadayıf wrapped around walnuts or pistachios, fried and soaked in syrup. A favourite Erzurum dessert, said to go back to Seljuk times.

dishes.name: Erzurum su böreği
dishes.desc: Layered pastry baked with local string cheese, using one egg for each sheet of dough. A staple of Erzurum breakfast tables.

dishes.name: Lor dolması
dishes.desc: Chard leaves wrapped around a bulgur filling, a home-style stuffed dish from the Erzurum kitchen.

dishes.name: Lalanga
dishes.desc: A fried batter treat served with sugar or syrup, described as an ancestor of pancakes and crêpes. Part of the traditional Erzurum table.
